baseline_rule: 3 strictly rising (long) or falling (short) 15m closes; signal at the third close.
breakout_rule: 3 rising oriented impulse candles + 1 opposing handle + closed confirmation beyond handle; 5-50% retracement; handle low above impulse origin; handle high within 0.2% of impulse peak; confirmation quote-volume / handle quote-volume >= threshold.

cost_scenarios_round_trip_bps.12: Two taker fees at 6 bps per side, matching the BTCUSDT/selected stock contract snapshot observed 2026-11-01; historical fee constancy is unverified.
cost_scenarios_round_trip_bps.22: 12 bps fee scenario plus 10 bps assumed round-trip spread/slippage.
cost_scenarios_round_trip_bps.37: 12 bps fee scenario plus 25 bps assumed round-trip spread/slippage.

entry_exit_assumption: Signal is known at candle close; entry at next 15m candle open; exit at that candle close; MFE/MAE use that candle high/low. No spread, fill queue, gaps beyond OHLC, funding, or market impact.
interpretation: Signals overlap and are event-level observations, not a portfolio backtest. Fee/spread values are scenarios, not measured historical execution costs. No leverage is applied.
